Year 3,347 - One hundred and fifty-three years before the Great Convergence
For the first time in decades, he could not feel Torrhen's presence flowing through the Deep Waters that connected all consciousness.
The Sage's consciousness expanded through quantum foam, searching for the harmonic signature that had become as familiar as his own heartbeat.

The geological wisdom that had guided their partnership, the mystical intuition that had made synthesis possible, the ancient patience that had taught reality itself to dance—all of it flowing outward through dimensional barriers, merging with forces so vast that individual identity became meaningless within their scope.

The Sage felt tears streaming down his face without understanding why, his consciousness torn between mathematical recognition of necessity and emotional resistance to loss that would reshape everything he had become during their partnership.
